issue_context.title: new rule: unnecessary brackets in class definition
issue_context.body:
```
class Foo():
    pass
```
should be written as:
```
class Foo:
    pass
```

A new rule could cover this.
comments: Not to weigh in one way or another, but just a note that black will rewrite the first example as the second.

review_comments: In which case would there be more than one parentheses pair in a class without bases?
I don't think there should be, but it felt more robust to generalize to that case.
